message.reasoning_content:
The vendor is known and on file since 2024.

This is an uncorrected resubmission of invoice INV-1013, which was previously rejected. Every reject-severity finding must be addressed. The risk memo is low severity but still requires a reason. I will output a JSON rejection with all five findings addressed and a brief summary for the finance manager.

The low risk memo does not override the reject findings. Each reason will include its finding IDs.

The schema requires finding_ids for every reason. The risk memo is not a finding, so I will either cite it in a reason that also references the findings or use an empty array.

I will weave the low risk memo into a reason that also cites the reject findings, so finding_ids is never empty. The first reason addresses F1: the invoice total of 22,562.80 does not match the line items plus tax, which sum to 22,512.80, leaving an unexplained +50.00.

F2 is a duplicate of the previously rejected INV-1013. The vendor master shows this invoice was returned to the vendor and the revision field is null.

F3 through F5 show stock exceeded on WidgetA, WidgetB, and GadgetX. We cannot pay for quantities we do not have or that exceed available stock.

The low risk memo does not outweigh the five reject-severity findings. Payment would be blocked at the gate regardless.
